retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast vertical split layout featuring oversized sans-serif typography and a small inset photograph.
triggerTerms: vertical split layout with large sans-serif text
Swiss style album cover with inset photo
bold black and white typography grid

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, grid-based composition divided into a large white section on the left and a narrow black vertical band on the right. The left side features four rows of massive, black sans-serif text with a small rectangular color photo inset in the top right corner. The right side contains two columns of white vertical text rotated 90 degrees.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetric balance between the wide white field and narrow black column
Scale contrast between the massive display type and the small inset photograph
Color inversion between the black-on-white left side and white-on-black right side
Strict vertical and horizontal alignment following a rigid grid
coreInvariants: Vertical black bar occupying approximately one-third of the right-hand width
Oversized, condensed sans-serif typography as the primary visual element
Small rectangular photographic inset framed by a thin red border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is the dominant subject, scaled to fill the majority of the frame. The photograph is secondary, positioned as a small anchor in the upper right of the white section.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The small red-bordered photograph acts as a focal point against the monochromatic text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves down the four rows, then shifts to the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with letterforms.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background for the main body
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for the vertical bar and primary text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for the photo border and small logo element
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value contrast (black/white) with a single high-saturation red accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different colors and orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, industrial sans-serif feel of the era.
Provides the clean Swiss-style geometry required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical split canvas with a wide white section on the left and a narrow black section on the right. Place a small rectangular color photograph in the upper right of the white section, framed by a thin red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, black condensed sans-serif text in four rows on the white section. Add two columns of white condensed sans-serif text rotated 90 degrees clockwise inside the black section.

verificationChecks: Is the right-hand bar solid black?
Is the text on the right rotated 90 degrees?
Is the photo inset small relative to the text?
Is the font a bold, condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Width of the black vertical bar
Color of the inset photo border
Number of text rows on the left
mustRedesign: Specific band member faces in the photo
The 'Deram' logo and specific catalog numbers
Exact wording of the title and artist

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is correctly rotated.
Ensure the red border is thin and precise.
Verify the black/white split is a clean vertical line.
Confirm the typography is condensed and bold.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen layout + Oversized Sans-Serif + Inset Photo Anchor
